name: Allen Harim Foods
old_description: Allen Harim is a leading producer of No Antibiotic Ever chicken with deep roots on the Delmarva Peninsula and across the Mid-Atlantic. With more than 100 years of experience, our company employs more than 1,700 team members and contracts with more than 210 family farmers. Our dedication to our customers, to deliver quality, service, and value is the cornerstone of our company. Our commitment to animal welfare, environmental concerns, and giving back to the community will always be at the forefront. This is who we are, and our promise to you. #WeAreAllenHarim
about:
Allen Harim Foods, based in Harbeson, Delaware, traces its origins to 1926 on the Delmarva Peninsula. The company has grown from its regional roots to become a significant poultry producer in the Mid-Atlantic, employing over 1,700 people and partnering with more than 210 family farmers.

The company specializes in No Antibiotic Ever chicken, overseeing the process from farm partnerships through processing. Its operations span hatcheries, feed mills, and processing facilities, though specific facility sizes and volumes are not disclosed. The scale is reflected in its workforce and farmer network.

Allen Harim serves customers across the food industry, including retail, foodservice, and further processors in the Mid-Atlantic and beyond. The company emphasizes quality, service, and value as cornerstones of its customer relationships.

The business differentiates itself through its No Antibiotic Ever commitment, animal welfare standards, environmental stewardship, and community engagement. These principles were highlighted as central to its identity and promise to customers.
